beats.headline: An Elle spell
beats.text: Carl asks about the other spell book, hoping to take Donut's mind off her blue claws, and she brightens. It's an Elle spell! The spell book thumps onto the table, and when Carl picks it up it is freezing cold. Ice Slick covers the ground in ice an inch thick over a wide area, how wide depending on intelligence and the spell's level. Carl has seen it used a few times now. This copy is a special edition, so it starts at level 5 and trains faster. This is great, he says.

beats.headline: A frozen river
beats.text: The raft waits on the River of Sloth, which is full of inner-tube gingers. Carl, who has eaten Mehmet's page from his Book of Boom, lays Gutter Bumper along the river. Donut leans forward and casts Ice Slick, and in seconds the whole river freezes, cracking, splitting and exploding, the ice following the bumpers half as far again as it would reach in its usual cone. Hundreds of gingers are stuck in place. The truck drives over the dock and onto the ice, dragging every spare non-magical weapon from Carl's inventory behind it on chains.

beats.headline: The dance floor
beats.text: In the mostly-music middle of Take On Me, with a brawl filling the Lollipop, Donut casts Ice Slick on the dance floor. A group of fighting NPCs goes spinning and crashes against the bar, into Prepotente, who is bent over the unattended counter rummaging behind it, and he flips with a yelp and disappears with a clatter.
